Read on if you want to find out what new and great items are currently available in the Atomic Shop, including free items of the week.

#### FREE ITEMS

The free items are knocking on the door again! Check out the Atomic Shop every day this week. Unless otherwise stated, each item is always available until 6:00 p.m. CET the following day.

Fallout 1st members can pick up a free carnival outfit for the upcoming carnival and the ammunition storage box until March 7th.
